description.value:
You mark a target with a persistent dark energy curse that eats away at them from within — and leaps to a new host when they fall.

Choose a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-dark-channel] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[void]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[void]] damage and gains @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[persistent,void]] damage (DC 15 flat check to end). When a creature affected by Dark Channel is reduced to 0 HP, the persistent void damage automatically transfers to the nearest enemy within 30 feet.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[persistent,void]] damage (DC 18 flat check to end).

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
